mentions.name: Glocker
mentions.description: An open source Linux app for developing healthy habits and routines: it blocks sites and applications based on a schedule and tracks user activity for later analysis.
mentions.problem: The author wanted comprehensive help developing healthy habits and routines on their computer, going beyond simpler versions they had built before.
mentions.audience: Used for the author's own personal habit development; released as an open source project for Linux users.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built an app to help me develop healthy habits and routines on my computer. IT blocks sites/apps based on a schedule and tracks my activity for later analysis.

evidence.value: I built an app to help me develop healthy habits and routines on my computer. IT blocks sites/apps based on a schedule and tracks my activity for later analysis.
